title: FilesListParams
description: List the entries of a directory on the pane's host. Symlinks are reported but never followed, .git directories are skipped, and the answer stops at the declared result bound rather than looking complete: truncated true means more entries exist and the path should be narrowed. Entry paths are the lexical paths the provider lists, the same names files.read takes.

path.description: Directory to list, inside the grant's paths.

recursive.description: Descend into subdirectories, breadth-first (a directory's own entries before any of its children's). Absent means false: only the named directory's entries.

result.title: FilesListResult
result.description: What files.list hands back. skipped counts what the traversal deliberately did not open, so a listing that left something out says so instead of looking complete.

path.description: The path that was listed, as the call spelled it.

recursive.description: Whether the call descended into subdirectories.

entries.description: The entries, in traversal order. Empty only for an empty directory or a very small result bound.

name.description: The entry's name within its directory.

path.description: The entry's lexical path — the name to pass to files.read, not a resolved identity.

kind.description: What the entry is. A symlink is listed as a symlink even when it resolves to a directory; its target is never entered. other is a FIFO, device or socket; unreadable means the entry exists but its metadata could not be read.

size.description: Size in bytes as the provider reported it; 0 or meaningless for directories, symlinks and pseudo-files.

modTime.description: Modification time, when the provider reported one.

linkTarget.description: The link's target as spelled, for a symlink only.

truncated.description: True when the traversal stopped at the declared result bound; more entries exist than were returned.

skipped.description: What the traversal refused to enter or open.

symlinks.description: Number of symlinks reported but not followed.
